Security & Compliance

Attestations

  • HITRUST CSF r2 certified
  • SOC 2 Type II
  • Business Associate Agreement executed with all provider customers

Coding Assist

Coding Assist is a machine-learning feature that reads encounter documentation and proposes billing codes.

  • Human review: Every suggestion is reviewed and accepted or rejected by a certified coder.
  • Model provider: Models are developed and hosted in-house by Meridian. No third-party model provider processes customer data.
  • Training: Meridian trains Coding Assist on de-identified customer encounter data under the limited data set provisions of the customer agreement. Customers may opt out on request.
  • Accuracy: Meridian publishes a quarterly accuracy report for Coding Assist to customers under NDA. Bias testing across patient demographic groups has not been published.
  • Logging: Coding Assist suggestions and coder decisions are written to the audit trail.
  • Retention: Suggestion records are retained for 7 years with the encounter record.

Data Residency

All customer data is stored in Meridian's US data centers. No offshore processing.

Incident Response

Meridian notifies customers of confirmed breaches within 48 hours, consistent with the executed BAA.
